snippet.title: Imagine We Were Human - Official Character Update Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Imagine We Were Human is a compilation of 12 small literary games about humans meeting and missing one another. Explore these experimental experiences that were made on a monthly basis over the course of a year. Imagine We Were Human's new trailer showcases the Character Update and what you can expect. Imagine We Were Human is available now on PC.
